highlights.quote: A measure does not merely collect violence. It defines the kind of violence that can be seen.
highlights.judgment: The book's controlling idea, stated early and genuinely earned by the evidence handling that follows.

highlights.quote: A point may serve hunting or fishing; lodged in human bone, it enters another category of evidence.
highlights.judgment: Excellent concrete reasoning about how material becomes evidence; typical of the book's best sentences.

highlights.quote: A ration was therefore more than food. It linked the body that worked to the authority that claimed the work.
highlights.judgment: Strong original-feeling synthesis: the Uruk bowl chain is the most memorable analytical passage in the book.

highlights.quote: The human impulse to harm requires no single historical origin; the power to make harm collective has a history.
highlights.judgment: Sharp thesis restatement, though it is one of many aphoristic chapter-closers that begin to feel manufactured.

highlights.quote: A file can be clean while its subject is filthy.
highlights.judgment: Rare moment of rhetorical heat in an otherwise cool register; effective precisely because it is unusual.

highlights.quote: A season can be harsh. A war is made.
highlights.judgment: Punchy, but an instance of the short antithetical closer the book reaches for too regularly.

highlights.quote: The cemetery shows the damage more clearly than it shows the organisation behind it.
highlights.judgment: Sound epistemic caution, yet the 'shows X more clearly than Y' formula recurs so often it stops carrying information.

highlights.quote: Their differences are not obstacles to comparison. They are what comparison has to preserve.
highlights.judgment: Elegant, but nearly every chapter ends on a variant of this same comparative moral, flattening the sense of progression.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Paired-case chapter architecture: two or three sites are described in sequence, then explicitly set side by side and declared incommensurable-but-comparable. The move is identical in all fifteen chapters.
instances: Nataruk and Warwickshire can be placed side by side only if their differences remain visible.
Here the Inca roads provide a useful contrast without erasing the difference between the two empires.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Symmetrical epistemic hedge closing almost every section: an assertion of what a source establishes, immediately balanced by what it cannot establish.
instances: Violence can be identified more securely than intention.
The evidence supports repeated projectile violence affecting men, women, and children. It does not provide a complete account of the attacks.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Negation-then-substitution antithesis ('not X; it is Y', 'it did not A, it B'), used several times per page as the default sentence engine.
instances: The stele does not show an instinct becoming stronger. It shows a political claim becoming wider, better supplied, and harder to escape.
Ireland's monasteries were not merely isolated places of prayer.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Terminal recap triad or quartet listing every case just discussed, then denying that any of them measures aggression.
instances: A healed cranial wound, a mass grave, a ration bowl, a boundary stone, a royal inscription, and a ceremonial palette do not measure one underlying quantity.
A burial, a palace relief, a ration bowl, a deportation order, a satellite image, and a testimony session do not observe the same thing.

recurringPatterns.pattern: The 'restraint and coercion travel through the same office' formula, restated with new nouns in nearly every chapter rather than developed further.
instances: Restraint and coercion travelled through the same office.
The same practice that reduced one threat could create suffering for those moved. Order and harm travelled together.

summary: This is an unusually disciplined comparative history of organized violence, built on a genuine thesis: aggression has no single measurable quantity across time, and what looks like its history is largely a history of the institutions and records that make particular harms visible. The evidential handling is the book's greatest strength — sites, dates, documents and objects are described with real specificity, and the reasoning about what a wound, a tablet, a quota or a dataset can and cannot support is consistently careful and often illuminating. Clarity and sentence craft are high, and the prose avoids nearly all lexical AI tics: no listicles, no chirpy pivots, no vague uplift. The weakness is structural sameness. Every chapter runs the same engine — paired cases, an explicit side-by-side, a symmetrical hedge, an aphoristic closer, a recap catalogue — and the negation-then-substitution sentence recurs so often that the voice, though distinctive, becomes monotone across four hundred pages of argument. Pacing suffers accordingly: the epistemic caution that is principled at chapter one reads as a tic by chapter twelve, and several composed passages fuse three or four analytical units into a single unbroken paragraph. With variation of chapter form, pruning of the repeated caveats, and a few more chapters willing to advance a claim rather than bound one, this would be publishable work.
